mapper.select: SELECT S.STORE_NO, STORE_NAME, MENU_NO, MENU_NAME, MENU_PRICE, M_STATUS FROM STORE S LEFT JOIN STORE_MENU M ON S.STORE_NO = M.STORE_NO WHERE M_STATUS = 'Y' AND S.STORE_NO = #{storeNo}
SELECT STORE_NO, FILE_NO, FILE_PATH, FILE_NAME, ORIGIN_NAME, IS_MAIN FROM STORE_FILE WHERE STORE_NO = #{storeNo} ORDER BY IS_MAIN DESC, FILE_NO ASC

SELECT SLOT_NO, STORE_NO, SLOT_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(SLOT_TIME, '%H:%i') AS SLOT_TIME, CAPACITY, CUR_COUNT, IS_AVAILABLE FROM RSV_SLOT WHERE STORE_NO = #{storeNo} AND SLOT_DATE = #{targetDate} ORDER BY SLOT_TIME ASC

SELECT S.STORE_NO, STORE_NAME, S_ADDR, S_STATUS, LAT, LNG, C.KOR AS STORE_TYPE, S_CONTENTS FROM STORE S LEFT JOIN CODE C ON S.S_CATEGORY = C.VALUE LEFT JOIN STORE_DETAIL D ON S.STORE_NO = D.STORE_NO WHERE TYPE = 'S_CATEGORY' AND S.STORE_NO = #{storeNo}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rsv_slot WHERE SLOT_NO = #{slotNo} AND IS_AVAILABLE = 'Y'
AND CUR_COUNT < CAPACITY

SELECT R.RSV_NO, R.SLOT_NO, SL.SLOT_DATE, SL.SLOT_TIME, R.USER_ID, P.PET_NAME, P.SPECIES, P.BREED, M.MENU_NAME, M.MENU_PRICE, R.REQUEST, S.STORE_NO, S.STORE_NAME FROM RESERVATION R JOIN RSV_SLOT SL ON R.SLOT_NO = SL.SLOT_NO JOIN PET P ON R.PET_NO = P.PET_NO JOIN STORE_MENU M ON R.MENU_NO = M.MENU_NO JOIN STORE S ON R.STORE_NO = S.STORE_NO WHERE R.RSV_NO = #{rsvNo}

SELECT RSV_NO AS rsvNo, USER_ID AS userId, RSV_STATUS AS rsvStatus FROM reservation WHERE RSV_STATUS = 'CNF' AND STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(RSV_DATE, ' ', RSV_END_TIME), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation ( SLOT_NO, RSV_DATE, RSV_START_TIME, RSV_END_TIME, STORE_NO, USER_ID, PET_NO, MENU_NO, REQUEST, RSV_STATUS, CDATE ) VALUES ( #{slotNo}, #{date}, #{time}, DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{date}, ' ', #{time}), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'), INTERVAL (SELECT slot FROM store_policy WHERE store_no = #{storeNo}) MINUTE), #{storeNo}, #{userId}, #{petNo}, #{menuNo}, #{request}, 'WAI', NOW() )

INSERT INTO rsv_log ( RSV_NO, ACTION, OLD_STATUS, NEW_STATUS, ACTOR_TYPE, ACTOR_ID, LOG_DATE, REMARK ) VALUES ( #{rsvNo}, #{action}, #{oldStatus}, #{newStatus}, IFNULL(#{actorType}, 'USER'), #{userId}, NOW(), #{remark} )
INSERT INTO review (USER_ID, STORE_NO, RSV_NO, RATING, R_CONTENTS, CDATE) VALUES (#{userId}, #{storeNo}, #{rsvNo}, #{rating}, #{rContents}, NOW())
INSERT INTO review_file (REVIEW_NO, FILE_PATH, FILE_NAME, ORIGIN_NAME, FILE_SIZE, FILE_EXT) VALUES (#{reviewNo}, #{file_path}, #{file_name}, #{origin_name}, #{file_size}, #{file_ext})
mapper.update:
UPDATE rsv_slot s JOIN store_policy sp ON s.STORE_NO = sp.STORE_NO SET s.IS_AVAILABLE = 'N' WHERE s.IS_AVAILABLE = 'Y' /* 현재 시간 + Cutoff 정책 시간이 슬롯 시간보다 크거나 같으면 마감 */
AND TIMESTAMP(s.SLOT_DATE, s.SLOT_TIME) <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL COALESCE(sp.CUTOFF, 0) HOUR)
UPDATE RSV_SLOT SET CUR_COUNT = CUR_COUNT - 1, /* 카운트가 줄어들면 무조건 수용량(CAPACITY) 미만이 되므로 Y로 변경 */ IS_AVAILABLE = 'Y' WHERE SLOT_NO = #{slotNo} AND CUR_COUNT > 0 /* 0 이하로 내려가는 것 방지 */
